properties.title: M 6.8 - 26 km W of Chauk, Myanmar

contents.bytes: Four people killed and more than 230 buildings damaged in five regions, including Magway, Mandalay, Rakhine State and Sagaing. Ancient monuments were damaged in the Bagan area. Felt (V) at Pakokku and (IV) at Mandalay, Pyinmana and Sittwe. Also felt (V) at Bara Bazar and (IV) at Ambassa, Bhubaneshwar, Chakdaha, Kolkata and Raniganj, India. Felt (IV) at Chittagong, Dhaka and Tungi, Bangladesh. Felt (III) at Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Pak Kret and Phra Pradaeng, Thailand. Felt in much of Bangladesh and Burma and in large parts of eastern and northeastern India and in northwestern Thailand. Felt at Thimphu, Bhutan and at Hanoi, Vietnam. Also felt at Biratnagar, Kirtipur and Waling, Nepal.
